title: Shortlisted for an Oscar, 'Homebound' is a daring movie about two dear friends
summary: The movie, now streaming on Netflix, defied current trends in Indian cinema to tell the true story of a friendship between a Muslim and a Hindu Dalit. Martin Scorsese was secretly involved.
